description:
Remove a single patron credential field.

Deletes one field from stored credentials without affecting
other fields. Free. Proof of npub ownership is required —
this is a write to the patron's sensitive credential vault.

dpop_token.description:
Proof that the caller holds npub: the grant envelope from
receive_npub_proof, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed
by npub whose `u` tag is this tool's name.

field.description: The credential field name to remove.

name: taxsort_delete_patron_credential
title: Delete patron credential
